newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguayan agriculture up 12 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Paraguayan agriculture up 12 pct in 1997.

text.p: Revenues from sales of Paraguayan agricultural products are expected to grow 12 percent this year, the central bank said Monday.
The bank provided no total figures for this year or 1996. It said the main reason for the expected increase is an anticipated 12.7 percent growth in soybean production volume this year.
Revenues from farm products rose one percent last year, the bank said. ((-Jose Maria Amarilla, Asuncion Newsroom 595 21 444527))
